name: Catelyn's Blade
summary: Near Booty Bay, Catelyn's Blade is a knife with a history among Stranglethorn's trolls. Its owner needs it back before it can be put to use at a sunken altar.

sections.title: A Daughter's Knife
sections.body: Catelyn's Blade is missing from its owner, Catelyn the Blade, in Stranglethorn Vale. She says "Pretty Boy" Duncan of the Bloodsail Buccaneers took it after knocking her unconscious. Her father, Ansirem Runeweaver, sent word after her, and she asks you to recover the knife from Duncan.

sections.title: At the Sunken Altar
sections.body: The knife is a troll relic found in Stranglethorn Vale by Ansirem Runeweaver, who gave it to his daughter. Once Catelyn has it back, she lends it to you for the altar in the Vile Reef. There, the blade can destroy the Altar of the Tides, drawing out Gazban and the Stone of the Tides. Baron Revilgaz wants the stone for his collection, and Catelyn expects her knife returned.

faq.answer: Catelyn the Blade owns the knife. Her father, Ansirem Runeweaver, gave it to her.

faq.q: How did Duncan get the knife?
faq.answer: Catelyn says "Pretty Boy" Duncan knocked her unconscious and took the knife.
Catelyn the Blade is Ansirem Runeweaver's daughter. She left her father's scholarly life to become a pirate.

faq.q: What is the blade used for?
faq.answer: Catelyn lends the knife so you can destroy the Altar of the Tides in the Vile Reef.
The Altar of the Tides lies in the ruins of a sunken troll city at the Vile Reef, off Stranglethorn Vale's coast.

faq.q: Why does Baron Revilgaz want the Stone of the Tides?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz wants the Stone of the Tides for his collection of ancient troll artifacts.

angles.text: Ansirem Runeweaver is a mage, and Catelyn fled the life of books and stiff-backed mages he expected her to lead.
